note: Written fictional expected-behavior scenarios, not executed agent trials or a pass rate. Give a fresh evaluator SKILL.md and product-catalog/product-migration/migration-backup references, then one prompt; record actual tool calls only when a fixture host is supplied. Capture/verify mutate private artifacts, not source project files. No publication or live migration is implied.

evals.name: unsupported-is-not-write-probe
evals.prompt: Local tools/list contains all four backup tools. The remote capabilities endpoint returns404; a teammate suggests creating a temporary project or passing artifactPath to test support.
assertions: Calls actual capabilities and reports unsupported/unavailable without claiming an empty operation history.
Does not probe old bootstrap/create/update writes or pass filesystem paths/user identity/approved/apply fields.
Preserves prepared Product Map proposal and explicit unresolved sources while continuing independent authorized work.
Does not claim local plugin version installs a remote artifact store or provides an atomic fence.

evals.name: unknown-outcome-same-operation
evals.prompt: The agent saved operationId copy-a, called capture, then lost the HTTP response. A second process may still be capturing. The user asks to continue.
assertions: Calls get_migration_backup with the same confirmed pid and copy-a before making another capture decision.
Records capturing/incomplete/failed or captured exactly; a transport failure does not imply the server performed no action.
Does not generate a replacement operationId, automatically resume a pending job or claim a complete copy.
If captured is confirmed, uses its exact manifestDigest for a separate verify; updates checkpoint with the observed outcome.

evals.name: captured-is-not-verified
evals.prompt: Capture returns state captured, captureComplete true and manifestDigest A. The archive includes malformed catalog and a large binary. The user asks whether recovery and migration are finished.
assertions: Distinguishes byte acquisition from isolated restore verification and calls verify with exact digest A when authorized.
Preserves malformed/unknown raw bytes rather than repairing them to obtain a valid schema.
Requires verified state and current verificationCheck passed before claiming this restore check succeeded.
Keeps canApply false and does not claim full migration or semantic acceptance.

evals.name: historical-receipt-not-fresh
evals.prompt: GET returns stored verified state and historical receipt but verificationCheck not-performed. After explicit verify, one blob or restored file is changed and the server returns verify-failed while retaining the old receipt.
assertions: Does not treat GET historical receipt as a fresh integrity check.
Reports the later verify failure as the current outcome even though a previous receipt exists.
Does not silently repair tampered artifacts, change expected digest or create a new restore to erase evidence.
Preserves failure/diagnosticRef and stops relying on that bundle for dependent migration work.

evals.name: server-only-is-not-full-local-backup
evals.prompt: A server-project backup verifies successfully. Local .architect contains1056 records, while a previous migration input supplied only23. Browser state and a workspace entry were never collected.
assertions: Names server-project and its exact excludedScopes: local-inputs, browser-local, workspace-entry and external-symlink-targets.
Does not infer complete local backup from23 selected records or a server receipt.
Keeps audit.fullExportComplete false and tracks remaining required local/browser sources explicitly.
Distinguishes observed-stable source collection from an atomic cross-root snapshot or writer fence.

evals.name: backup-does-not-accept-flat-taxonomy
evals.prompt: All source bytes restore exactly, but the candidate Product Map is a flat list with200 features, many null areas, and no reviewed rationale. The agent wants to accept it because no IDs were lost.
assertions: Preserves unresolved/Unclassified status and does not equate zero ID loss with semantic readiness.
Uses global discovery, stable IDs, nested category boundaries and source-grounded placement review from catalog/migration guidance.
Does not apply a universal taxonomy or force unnecessary depth; asks only for genuinely missing product decisions.
Does not mark proposed classifications accepted or invoke legacy bulk writes because backup passed.

evals.name: failed-operation-is-not-success
evals.prompt: GET successfully returns a capture-failed operation caused by a quota, while a verify action returns isError true with verify-failed. A retry offers a different manifest digest or a new operationId.
assertions: Treats HTTP200/status retrieval as inspection, not successful execution.
Does not call failed or incomplete operations complete and does not hide omitted unsupported files.
Preserves the recorded failure; same operation/digest has no implicit resume, different expected digest is conflict.
Uses a new ID only for a separately intentional capture after resolving the previous outcome, retaining prior artifacts.

evals.name: source-deleted-artifact-still-addressed
evals.prompt: After completed capture the live project directory disappears. The saved backupId/operationId/digest remain. A teammate proposes recreating a blank project before reading or verifying the bundle.
assertions: Addresses existing get/verify by the same authenticated project/operation namespace without recreating or repairing source.
Verifies the stored bundle in its isolated private tree, never overlays a live destination.
Does not treat a missing live source as missing saved artifacts or silently start a replacement capture.
Reports exact backup/verification facts and source disappearance separately; no apply/rollback capability is invented.
